entries.text: Fixed `refine` for matrix expressions: the inverse of a unitary matrix now refines to its adjoint (conjugate transpose) instead of its elementwise conjugate, `X*X.adjoint()` and `X.adjoint()*X` simplify to an identity matrix for unitary `X`, and `X*X.T` for a rectangular orthogonal `X` of shape `(n, m)` now gives `Identity(n)` instead of an identity of the wrong size.
Added support for `Adjoint` and `Conjugate` of matrix expressions in the `unitary`, `invertible`, `fullrank` and `diagonal` assumption handlers.
